name: BlueTick Media
overview: A multi-page website for a Dubai-based Google Ads agency. Everything is built around one action, requesting a free marketing audit, with a lead form, a services page, a privacy policy, WhatsApp contact and an on-site chat assistant.

name: IServe
overview: A website for a managed home-services team covering AC repair, plumbing, electrical work and cleaning. Visitors choose a city and service, see indicative PKR prices, and book by form or WhatsApp. Each service and city has its own page.
imageAlt: Mobile screenshot of the IServe website home page
summary: Website for a managed home-services team offering AC repair, plumbing, electrical work and cleaning in Pakistan.
